method: Web research against the ICP scoring model. Direct site crawling was blocked by session egress policy; every field below is sourced from search-indexed page content and public directory listings.

locations.name: Chandler
locations.address: 3960 E Riggs Rd, Ste 5, Chandler, AZ 85249

leads.phone_gap: Gilbert is dark Friday through Sunday — three consecutive days. Chandler closes Friday noon. Two locations, four published numbers, zero after-hours coverage.
leads.growth_trigger: Second location; dedicated new-patient funnel at go.riggsfamilydental.com
leads.why: Textbook ICP. Three docs, two sites, elective-heavy, and a paid new-patient funnel with call-tracking numbers — they already believe inbound calls are revenue. Gilbert being closed Fri-Sun means a 72-hour hole every single week on a line that paid traffic is pointed at.
leads.open_with: Ask what happens to a Gilbert implant enquiry that calls Friday afternoon.
leads.contact: Dr. Carlos Lopez (owner, financial buyer); office manager as champion

locations.name: Mesa
locations.hours: Mon 8-5, Tue 8-5, Wed CLOSED, Thu 8-5, Fri 8-4, Sat-Sun closed

promos: $89 new-patient exam + digital x-rays + cleaning (all three locations)
leads.phone_gap: Mesa is closed Wednesday — a mid-week business day where every inbound call hits voicemail — plus both weekend days. Three sites, three separate numbers, no shared after-hours coverage.
leads.growth_trigger: Scaled to three locations across the Valley; actively adding associates (team bios still being filled in)
leads.why: Founder-owned and visibly expanding — three sites, one owner, no committee. Dr. Dawood is personally certified in Invisalign, implants and sedation, so the high-ticket work runs through her chair. The Wednesday closure is the tell: a full business day of paid-traffic calls going to voicemail.
leads.open_with: Ask where Wednesday's Mesa calls go, and what that costs across three locations.

locations.name: Chandler
locations.address: 3150 S Gilbert Rd, Ste 1, Chandler, AZ 85286
locations.hours: Mon 7-3, Tue 8-5, Wed 8-5, Thu 7-4, Fri 7-3, Sat-Sun closed

promos: FREE initial dental implant consultation + CT scan ($245 value)
leads.phone_gap: Closed both weekend days; Monday and Friday close at 3pm. Three published phone numbers with no after-hours answer point.
leads.growth_trigger: Third-generation dentist (Dr. Tyler) added to the roster; dedicated implant-consult campaign
leads.why: Family-owned means one dinner-table decision, no procurement. The free implant consult + CT offer is the single most expensive lead magnet on this list — every one of those calls is a $3-5k case in motion, and they stop being answerable at 3pm Friday until Monday morning.
leads.open_with: Ask what a free-implant-consult lead is worth, then what happens to the ones that call at 4pm Friday.

leads.owner: Dr. Alexander Matheson + Dr. Samantha Holder (30 yrs combined)

locations.name: Chandler
locations.address: 2815 E Ocotillo Rd, Ste 3, Chandler, AZ 85249

promos: $59 emergency exam + x-ray for new patients
leads.phone_gap: BIGGEST GAP ON THE LIST. Open Mon-Thu 8-4 only — 32 hours covered out of 168. Closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday. 136 hours a week where an All-on-4 enquiry cannot reach a human.
leads.growth_trigger: Positioned as an implant center; full three-tier sedation stack
leads.why: The strongest high-ticket stack in the set — IV sedation plus All-on-4 means individual cases in the $20-30k range — paired with the worst coverage. They advertise same-day emergency care while being unreachable 81% of the week. Two owners, both clinical, nobody free to answer.
leads.open_with: They sell same-day emergencies but are closed Fri-Sun. Ask where Friday's emergency calls land.
leads.contact: Dr. Alexander Matheson or Dr. Samantha Holder (co-owners)

leads.owner: Dr. John Cismas (bought the practice in 2025)
leads.doctor_count: 2-4 (roster in transition post-acquisition; verify on call)

locations.name: Mesa
locations.address: 855 E Brown Rd, Ste 4, Mesa, AZ 85203

leads.phone_gap: Closed both weekend days, Friday ends at 2pm. A 70-year-old patient base generating call volume against a front desk covering ~37 hours.
leads.growth_trigger: OWNERSHIP CHANGE 2025 — Dr. Cismas bought a practice operating since 1955. Strongest urgency trigger on the list.
leads.why: New owner, 70-year-old patient base, in-house oral surgery. A dentist who just bought a practice is the most motivated buyer in dentistry — he is carrying acquisition debt and every unanswered call is money he personally financed. In-house oral surgery means high-value cases already route through this line.
leads.open_with: Congratulate him on the acquisition, then ask how many inherited-patient calls got missed last month.
leads.contact: Dr. John Cismas (new owner — financial buyer, high urgency)
leads.caveat: Doctor count and current promos are the two unverified fields. Confirm both before the pitch.
